name: Unitech International Limited
about: Unitech International Limited manufactures and sells acrylic MMA monomers, acrylic sheets, and other polymers in India and internationally. It offers engineering plastics, MMA, PMMA, plastic and polymers, plastic media blast, cast acrylic sheets, acrylic articles, acrylic granules, various types of plastic import and alloy metals, and HMS 1 and 2 ferrous and non-ferrous, as well as polycarbonate, polystyrene, ABS, and nylon products. The company's products have applications in paint, adhesive, leather, and paper industries; chemical and acrylic sheet plants; and automotive glazing, advertising signs, interior lighting panels, exterior panels, decorative panels, bathroom fittings, acrylic decorative walls, and acrylic pipes. It also engages in the trading business. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
